definition: my attitude to sex getting worse over the years, and what I would choose

settled:
Over the years my attitude toward sex has been getting worse. The honest reading is that it takes from my life much more than it adds.

I have often felt that if I could choose to not have sex at all, and never feel the desire for it, I would want that.

A high proportion of couples stop having sex in their forties, usually at the man's instigation. That is not a conversation Jen is really open to at the moment, so this is my own reading rather than anything we have decided together.

title: How I Feel About Sex Now
